intro: Viewers ask a yes-or-no question with a channel point reward or an optional chat command, and the Magic 8-Ball answers in the chat the question came from. No Streamer.bot import is needed.

sections.title: 1. Rewards
sections.notice: Create a reward such as "Magic 8-Ball" with "Require viewer to enter text" turned on, then paste its ID here (right-click the reward in Streamer.bot and choose Copy Reward Id). Answers go only to that platform's chat.

sections.title: 2. Chat command (optional)
sections.notice: Cooldowns apply to the command only. Restart StreamBridge after changing the command.

sections.title: 4. Overlay
sections.notice: Add http://127.0.0.1:8787/overlay/addons/thsv.magic-eight-ball as a 1920x1080 browser source in the scenes where it should show.
